title: Use a faithful BKM tangent quotient to falsify a proposed pinching contraction
statement: For a faithful baseline sigma and a physical cross-sector tangent H with the stated marginal constraints, a local quotient g_(N sigma)(N H)/g_sigma(H) above 1/2 rules out the proposed half-contraction for that pinching step.

requires: Faithful baseline and Hermitian tangent; verify trace and marginal constraints and positivity of sigma+tH for sufficiently small nonzero t.
provides: A local obstruction to the asserted BKM half-contraction and to using that pinching as a monotone reduction.
assumptions: The ratio is a local metric test; it is not itself a global relative-entropy or target-inequality violation.
costs: Exact BKM matrix formulas and a scoped interval enclosure at the declared epsilon.
contract.obstruction: A finite block slack may exceed the coherence gain. This operation only falsifies the specified contraction proof step.

evidence.status: Exact selected source bytes; internal acceptance applies only through a version-bound overlay.
